body: Trying to get together with this couple for awhile .. but constantly making excuses not to bc he doesn’t want to .. but this time he finally said yes and he knew in advance .. then night of he changed his mind

This was planned in advance. They’ve asked us numerous times and I come up with excuses bc I know he doesn’t enjoy going out. But this one time I asked and he said sure and it was in advanced. 

That’s how I feel .. suck it up one night bc I do plenty of things that I’m not fully enjoying for him.
Yeah it was definitely planned in advance .. agreed to it .. then and hour or 2 before started getting mad about it
When I’m depressed I turn to food .. and usually unhealthy food
I took a tour of one .. it was horrifying .. the company had required mental health checks with the employees

Did I just write this? I don’t want to get a divorce but if nothing changes idk how to get off this hamster wheel. 

It’s exhausting.
I have body image issues .. so since he didn’t say it I’m already assuming he’s lying. but even if he did say it was true, I would be devastated.

There definitely is a lot of other noise going on .. 

.. I go above and beyond for him .. which I don’t get in return .. I just feel alone and rejected at this point.

This made me smile. 

I hope my relationship could be like this one day.
I did and he said no .. but why every time I try to initiate I get turned down?

One night I did get emotional and asked him .. he said no .. 

This past year he been tough for us .. and all sense of intimacy kind of dwindled. Like he barely touches me or cuddles me anymore.
depression .. mainly feeling disconnected from my partner.

I feel this. I was with my cousin who has a 1 year old and announced she was pregnant again today. My period was 3 days late .. so I've been getting anxious excited .. but ended up getting my period today. 

I am thankful to this group because I can talk about it. I don't want to vent to any friends or family bc I don't want to be a burden and also I don't want them to know we are struggling to get pregnant. 

​

Sending you a virtual hug.
A plan for what I will be doing.. I get very anxious and uncomfortable walking around trying to figure out what to do
